data.narrative:
Star Catcher is a Series A space & aerospace company that has raised $88M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a comparable universe of 5 public equities (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private peers spanning the sector, including SpaceX, Rocket Lab, and Planet Labs.

Two valuation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis, anchoring to the $88M total raised and applying a 2.0x multiplier typical of Series A to next-stage step-ups, implies a valuation of $176M. Peer-median analysis across three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables (Cowboy Space Corporation at $2.0B, Aalyria at $1.3B, Starcloud at $1.1B) yields a median of $1.3B. Public-comp anchoring cannot be applied due to the absence of Star Catcher's revenue data. The public sector median P/S of 25.3x across six traded companies is noted for context but not executable here.

The triangulated analysis across two methods supports a valuation range of $150M (low) to $1.5B (high), with a median of $738M. The wide spread reflects acute uncertainty around Star Catcher's revenue trajectory and competitive position relative to the peer set. Stage-progression implies conservatively; peer medians imply substantially higher. Materiality hinges on revenue run-rate, unit economics, and technical differentiation versus named competitors.
